records.reason: Best baseline: contemporaneous OSCE finding on incumbent-tilting constitutional and legal changes, plus restricted competition.
Useful corroboration that independent observation was sharply limited, but narrower than the substantive election report.
Foundational background on the constitutional reset; useful context, but older and secondary to the OSCE material.
Later retrospective judgment on the same constitutional trajectory; informative, but not period-contemporaneous.
Direct, period-specific statement on state media censorship at the start of the invasion.
Adds concrete arrest scale and platform blocking, making it stronger than individual protest anecdotes.
Repetitive anti-war protest-detention incident; no material fact beyond the broader crackdown already captured.
Another protest-detention incident repeating the same suppression pattern without a new material fact.
Illustrative wire reporting on the fake-news law and charging of protesters, but it overlaps the broader censorship evidence.
Best year-end quantitative synthesis of arrests, criminal cases, blocking, and treason prosecutions.
Russian-language duplicate of the OVD-Info year-end repression report.
Distinct civil-society suppression example: closure and delisting of Amnesty and other NGOs.
Another Amnesty overview of the same repression wave; useful but redundant with stronger retained summaries.
Independent UN expert corroboration of harassment of journalists and mass arrests of demonstrators.
Strong year-end synthesis of political repression and political-prisoner counts.
Russian-language duplicate of the Memorial year-end report.
Distinct rights-restricting law on LGBT expression, showing broader social-control beyond protest censorship.
Current RSF summary corroborates the post-2022 media environment, but it is not a 2022-dated finding.
Best compact annual synthesis of the 2022 anti-dissent legal and enforcement drive.
Methodology note for OVD-Info; helpful for reliability but not conduct evidence.
Mission index only; useful for observation-history context, but not a findings document.

remaining_concerns: Several incident-level protest-detention reports were repetitive and had to be collapsed into broader repression evidence.
Some useful corroboration is retrospective or current-summary material rather than contemporaneous 2022 reporting.
Wire and media items are secondary to stronger IGO and NGO documentation, so the packet is concentrated in institutional and monitoring sources.
